tcd_identity_and_class.evidence: TCD-018 is governed as CONFIRMED_LEGACY_BALANCE_INTERFACE_STATE_OMISSION and Class A with an atomic balance-interface claim.

sic_sict_physical_ownership.evidence: PREP06 W-IC owns Sic as begin state and Sict as end state for canopy interception water; Init promotes Sic=Sict on the applicable detailed-hydrology route.

begin_end_storage_contribution.identity: external water in - external water out - delta(matrix + snow + ponding + interception) = 0

detailed_hydrology_closure.evidence: Hydro_detailed includes -(Sict-Sic) in Badev. For the natural LWKM 2008 period the summed detailed-hydrology Badev is -5.2640587582358e-5 mm while legacy Bawa reports -0.0601 mm.

bawa_interface_omission.evidence: Outbal_calc does not receive Sic or Sict and has no interception-storage contribution although it accounts interception evaporation and other water stores.

natural_b1_activation.evidence: PREP01 reconciles all 25 annual total-profile periods with the interception storage change, and MASSQ01 retains TCD-018 as LEGACY_REPORTING_ONLY_DIFFERENCE.

independent_conservation_oracle.identity: S0 + precipitation - evaporation - throughfall - S1 = 0 exactly

proposed_accounting_only_observation.evidence: The PREP01 causal probe observes and accumulates existing Sic/Sict storage only; no hydrology equation or state mutation is introduced.

hydrological_state_trajectory_noninterfe.evidence: The TCD-specific PREP01 probe records changed_hydrology_state=false. The combined Class-A PREP02 probe records state_or_process_physics_changed=false. MASSQ01 independently shows a read-only observer can run with zero physical-output differences across eight natural cases.

hydrological_flux_trajectory_noninterfer.evidence: The TCD-specific PREP01 probe records changed_hydrology_fluxes=false and changes no forcing or soil-water equation; the Class-A diagnostic comparison has zero unintended output differences.

output_whitelist.qualification_note: PREP02's eight-case matrix is a combined TCD-017/TCD-018 Class-A probe. Source localization separates TCD-018 to the six water-ledger files; the six P-ledger differences belong to TCD-017. A standalone isolated eight-case TCD-018 rerun is not claimed by this workunit.

no_unrelated_residual_masking.evidence: MASSQ01 retains the unrelated CranGrass TITO=724 water residual of -0.0030198960466805147 mm as UNEXPLAINED_RESIDUAL. TCD-018 does not claim global water closure.
